footer.description: A smarter football intelligence platform connecting Caribbean talent with the people shaping the future of the game.

hero.description: CFit brings players, coaches, academies, and professional scouts together through a smarter football intelligence platform built to connect Caribbean talent with opportunities.

whatIs.description: CFit connects the Caribbean football ecosystem in one trusted digital environment. We help organize player information, development pathways, and professional scouting access—making talent easier to understand and opportunity easier to navigate.

ecosystem.description: CFit gives every part of the talent journey the right tools to connect, organize, and discover.
